context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 features (Price Alerts and Backtesting) fully implemented and working. Backend API endpoints: /api/alerts/stats, /api/alerts/dashboard, /api/alerts/add (POST), /api/alerts/custom (GET), /api/alerts/{id} (DELETE), /api/alerts/threshold (POST), /api/alerts/mark-read/{id} (POST). Backtest endpoints: /api/backtest/compare/{symbol}, /api/backtest/rsi/{symbol}, /api/backtest/bb/{symbol}, /api/backtest/ema/{symbol}. Frontend pages: 'Alerts' tab shows PriceAlerts.jsx, 'Backtest' tab shows Backtesting.jsx. All data-testid attributes in place for automated testing.

components: Stats bar (Active Custom, Tracking, Alerts Today, Unread)
New Alert button - opens form modal
Create Price Alert form (Coin selector, Above/Below condition, Target Price input)
Custom Alerts list with delete buttons
Alert Feed with real-time dashboard alerts (RSI EXTREME, BREAKOUT types)
Auto-Alert Thresholds section (5min Move, 1h Move, RSI Oversold, RSI Overbought, Vol Spike)
Config panel (Symbol, Timeframe, Period, Strategy dropdowns)
Strategy-specific parameters (RSI: oversold/overbought, EMA: fast/slow, BB/RSI: stop_pct/target_pct)
Run Backtest button with loading state
Strategy cards with stats (Trades, Win Rate, PnL, Profit Factor, Max DD, Avg Win/Loss, Best/Worst)
Recent Trades table (Direction, Entry, Exit, PnL, Result)

alerts./api/alerts/dashboard: GET - Returns dashboard alerts with limit/unread_only params
alerts./api/alerts/add: POST - Adds custom price alert (symbol, target_price, direction)
alerts./api/alerts/custom: GET - Lists all custom price alerts
alerts./api/alerts/mark-read/{id}: POST - Marks dashboard alert as read

backtest./api/backtest/compare/{symbol}: GET - Compares all 3 strategies (RSI, BB, EMA)
backtest./api/backtest/rsi/{symbol}: GET - RSI Mean Reversion backtest with oversold/overbought params
backtest./api/backtest/bb/{symbol}: GET - Bollinger Band backtest with stop_pct/target_pct params
backtest./api/backtest/ema/{symbol}: GET - EMA Crossover backtest with fast/slow params

mocked_apis_note: Paper trading uses MOCKED execution (no real money). Backtesting uses REAL historical data from MEXC.
